page: Microsoft Azure ND96is_MI300X_v5 is an isolated, premium storage capable virtual machine belonging to the NDISv5MI300X family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 1850.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 19.27 GB of RAM per core.

This server type integrates eight GPUs to accelerate parallel computing tasks. For local storage, it includes 31769 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, offering substantial space and high-speed local data access. The instance is designed as an isolated resource, ensuring dedicated hardware allocation without multi-tenant interference on the host.

Given the massive memory footprint, high GPU count, and extensive local NVMe SSD storage, this server represents a high-density hardware profile. It is qualitatively positioned for resource-intensive workloads that require substantial parallel processing power and large local datasets. Suitable workloads include large-scale machine learning model training, deep learning inference, high-performance computing simulations, and large-scale database operations.
